night-desk-read.note: desk behind paper during the private read (lights down)

shadows.name: paper-rest
shadows.purpose: Separates screenplay paper from the workspace.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Indicates a dragged or opened story card.

components.name: Night Primary Button
components.description: Primary approval or forward action in Night mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-night { background:#DCA52E; color:#202321; border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:8px 12px; font:600 13px Inter,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary-night:hover { background:#E8B947; } .ds-btn-primary-night:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4E6B4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Story Card
components.description: Directly manipulable scene or beat on the visual board.
components.css: .ds-story-card { width:132px; background:#D6AE69; color:#202321; border:1px solid rgba(32,35,33,.24); border-radius:5px; padding:10px; display:grid; gap:5px; font:500 12px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-story-card small { font-size:10px; font-weight:650; } .ds-story-card:hover { box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(12,18,22,.22); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-story-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2C72C7; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Rewrite Pass Chip
components.description: Persistent pass selector with version and state.
components.css: .ds-pass-chip { background:#F4F1EA; color:#202321; border:1px solid #C8C4BA; border-radius:4px; padding:7px 10px; font:600 11px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; } .ds-pass-chip:hover { border-color:#2C72C7; } .ds-pass-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2C72C7; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: A professional screenplay page at the center of a cinematic editing suite, joined to the tactile intelligence of a physical writers' room.

rules.name: The Page Rule
rules.body: Theme switching changes the workspace, not the warm screenplay surface.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth explains interaction and is never ambient decoration.

dos: Use direct manipulation for spatial story work.
donts: Do not use a chatbot-first layout.
Do not use oversized typography or generic rounded-card grids.
Do not hide the screenplay behind analysis.
